text:
This denture clinic is highly impressive! They offer both affordable options and upgraded options at reasonable prices.

The dentist and assistants are lovely, kind, and provide excellent advice.
The clinic moved from Phatthanakan and is now located on the 2nd floor of the Shell gas station. There's both an elevator and stairs for easy access, and plenty of parking.

The process involves the dentist examining your teeth before taking impressions and allowing you to choose your tooth color (this choice is non-refundable). The base is made of soft material. You'll be scheduled for a fitting before the actual production begins. If it's not comfortable after the fitting, the dentist will adjust it and schedule another fitting. And if it's painful to wear, the dentist will provide free maintenance for the lifetime of the dentures.

Overall, the service is excellent and they are attentive to patients at every step. Highly recommended!
